GEM Content Engine — Customer Changelog
========================================

v1.7  ·  2026-05-13 (patched 2026-05-15)
----------------------------------------
Patches since the v1.7 release (no version bump — same lifetime license):

  - Carousel slides now ship ready-to-publish copy on first run. The
    Visual Director's per-slide "text" field used to occasionally echo
    schema labels like "Bold opening text" or "First key insight"; the
    prompt has been rewritten so every slide returns a finished hook,
    setup, point, reveal, or CTA in the niche you chose.

  - Agent Activity tiles are now interactive. Hover (or keyboard-focus)
    any mini-report tile in the right-hand activity panel and a styled
    card slides in next to it showing every field in its full,
    untruncated form — including expanded lists for Channels, Pillars,
    Candidate Topics, Trending Items, Sections, and Retention Hooks.
    Escape dismisses; scrolling auto-hides.

Original v1.7 release notes follow.

v1.7  ·  2026-05-13
-------------------
- Quality Bar: every drop is now graded against six rules before publish
  — one idea, two-second hook, specific examples, on-brand visuals,
  business-goal CTA, human approval beat.
- "Today's Brief" sample on the landing page: see exactly what a real
  drop looks like for an AI niche, no signup required.
- Roadmap teaser: the bigger workflow modules in development are now
  public on the site. Founder's Edition buyers vote on the order.
- Trending Mode CORS disclosure surfaced in the live FAQ — honest about
  the r/popular fallback for Google Trends.

v1.6
----
- Trending Mode: live Reddit / HackerNews / Google Trends signals.
- Photo Post Prompts: 5 ready-to-paste DALL-E 3 / Imagen prompts per
  piece for IG Feed, IG Reel, FB, TikTok, LinkedIn.
- Carousel Generator: multi-slide IG + LinkedIn carousels with role,
  headline, and image prompt per slide.
- Brand Kit fixed: hex input, native picker, 8 preset palettes.

v1.5
----
- My Library: auto-saved content history, one-click reload.
- 30-Day Calendar: AI-generated strategic content calendar.
- Tone Presets: 5 voice styles (Balanced / Educational / Entertaining /
  Controversial / Inspirational).
- Channel Export / Import: JSON sync across devices.

What's coming next
------------------
Founder's Edition buyers shape the roadmap. The four big modules in
active development:

  - Daily auto-brief — ranked content brief delivered every morning
  - Approval workflow — approve / edit / regenerate / reject + version history
  - Direct publish — push to Buffer, Later, Meta, YouTube
  - Performance loop — yesterday's winners feed tomorrow's brief

Lifetime updates means every release lands in your inbox at no extra
cost while you're on the v1.x major version. If v2.0 ships as a paid
upgrade, Founder's Edition buyers get a substantial discount.

Vote: reply to your purchase receipt email with the module you'd
prioritise. Real feedback drives the next sprint.

— The GEM team
  thegeminfo.com
